prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single universally “best” roofing company for every homeowner — the right contractor depends on your needs (budget, roof type, warranty expectations, whether it’s insurance work, timeline, etc.). I can help you find the best match. Before I do that, here are practical ways to identify a top roofing company in Dallas and what to ask them.

How to choose the best roofer
- Check credentials:
  - Insurance: Ask for proof of liability insurance and workers’ comp.
  - Certifications: Look for manufacturer certifications (GAF Master Elite, CertainTeed SELECT, Owens Corning Preferred). These indicate training and better warranties.
  - Local presence and licensing/registration: Confirm they operate in Dallas and have required local permits/registrations.
- Reputation and references:
  - Read recent Google, Yelp, and BBB reviews.
  - Ask for addresses of recent local jobs and call at least 2 references.
- Written estimates and contracts:
  - Get 3 written, itemized estimates (materials, labor, tear-off vs. overlay, disposal).
  - Ensure the contract lists start/completion dates, materials brands/colors, warranty details, and payment schedule.
- Warranties:
  - Distinguish manufacturer shingle warranty vs. contractor workmanship warranty and how long each lasts.
- Communication and professionalism:
  - Look for clear communication, timely responses, and someone who inspects your roof in person (not only by photo).
- Avoid storm-chaser red flags:
  - Don’t sign high-pressure offers from door-to-door contractors right after a storm. Verify their local address and credentials.

Questions to ask each company
- Are you licensed/registered to work in Dallas and can you provide COI (certificate of insurance)?
- What manufacturer certifications do you hold?
- Can you provide at least three local references and recent photos of similar jobs?
- Will you obtain all permits and handle inspections?
- What is the total cost and what’s included/excluded?
- What warranties are provided (length and coverage)?
- Who will be my point of contact and how do you handle cleanup?

Red flags
- No insurance or unwillingness to provide COI.
- Only accepts large upfront cash payments.
- High-pressure sales tactics or gives estimates without an on-site inspection.
- Vague contract terms or no written warranty.

How I can help next
- If you give me your ZIP code and any priorities (budget, best warranty, storm/insurance claim, asphalt vs. metal, small vs. large job), I’ll compile 3–5 highly rated Dallas-area roofers that match your needs and include their pros/cons and review summary.

Would you like me to find contractors for your area? If so, share your ZIP code and any priorities.
